安装所选更新？原版本与项目固定版本保留；个人名称、分类和图片不会被覆盖。: Install selected updates? Previous versions and project-pinned versions remain. Personal names, categories and images are preserved.
仅检查有仓库来源且未锁定的 Skill；检查不会自动安装，更新前可逐项查看文件变: Only unlocked Skills with repository sources are checked. Checks never install updates; review file changes before installation.
Skill 版本已变化，确认使用这些仍兼容的参数？不会修改原预设。: The Skill version has changed. Apply these compatible parameters? The original preset will not change.
此预设来自其他 Skill 版本；请核对参数变化。: This preset belongs to another Skill version. Review parameter changes.
按当前参数适配另存: Adapt and save a new preset
模板追加到现有内容，不会自动覆盖。预设仅属于当前 Skill。: Templates append to existing text without overwriting it. Presets belong to the current Skill.
包含未提交草稿与本地参考图: Include unsubmitted drafts and local references
恢复支持 1.2.0 起创建的备份，当前正式数据会保留为恢复前副本。当前草稿会保: Backups created with 1.2.0 or later are supported. Current data and drafts are preserved in a pre-restore copy. Codex credentials are excluded; another computer requires sign-in and image capability verification.
复制与校验完成后才切换，原目录保留。请选择空间充足的位置；迁移期间不能生成或关闭: The location changes only after copying and verification. The original directory remains. Choose a disk with enough space; generation and closing are unavailable during migration.
仅在应用打开且无生成任务时运行；关闭应用后不会运行。仅清理此目录中可识别的旧备份: Runs only while the app is open and no generation tasks are active. Only recognized old backups in this directory are pruned.
仅清理已校验正式原图的成功任务临时输出；不删除原图、参考图、Skill 版本或外: Remove only successful temporary outputs with verified durable originals? Originals, references, Skill versions and external Codex caches remain.
只检查当前数据目录；不会清理系统文件或外部 Codex 图片。: Checks only the current data directory. System files and external Codex images are never removed.
排队任务开始前不创建 Turn；关闭应用后不会自动重复提交。提高并发可能同时使用: Queued tasks do not create a Turn until execution starts. Closing the app never automatically resubmits them. Higher concurrency may consume more quota at once.
继续排队后将发送到 Codex，可能消耗额度。继续？: Continue queuing and send to Codex? This may consume quota.
重试会先核对已有结果，必要时新建 Turn 并消耗额度；原失败记录保留。继续？: Retry first checks existing results and may create a new Turn that consumes quota. The failed record remains. Continue?
项目 {0} · 版本 {1} · 原图 {2} · 参考图 {3} · 独占线: Projects {0} · Versions {1} · Originals {2} · References {3} · Exclusive threads {4} · Shared threads kept {5}
永久删除所选项目及其原图、参考图、历史版本和独占线程？不可恢复；外部导出与备份不: Permanently delete selected projects, originals, references, versions and exclusive threads? This cannot be undone. External exports and backups remain.
预设参数已变化，请先适配并另存。: Preset parameters have changed. Adapt and save a new preset first.
自动备份未完成，请检查目标磁盘与可用空间。: Automatic backup failed. Check the destination disk and free space.
当前未提交草稿也会保存在恢复前副本中；恢复后需要重新验证图片能力。跨账号的 Co: Current unsubmitted drafts are preserved in the pre-restore copy. Verify image capability again after restore. Codex sessions may not resume under another account.
草稿快照尚未完成。: The draft snapshot is not ready.
已有数据操作正在进行。: Another data operation is in progress.
诊断导出失败，请重试。: Could not export diagnostics. Please retry.
请先取消正在执行或排队的任务，再删除项目。: Cancel active and queued tasks before deleting projects.
聚焦当前页面搜索: Focus search on the current page
先关闭浮窗或菜单，再返回上一级: Close the dialog or menu first, then go back
仅在图片浮窗内缩放图片: Zoom images only inside the image dialog
当前正式数据将完整保留为恢复前副本，不会永久删除。当前未提交草稿也会保存在恢复前: Current data and unsubmitted drafts are preserved in a pre-restore copy. Verify image capability after restoring. Codex sessions may not resume with another account.
重新连接未完成。: Could not reconnect the data directory.
预览保持原图比例；改变画布不会拉伸或重新生成图片。实际输出尺寸以生成结果为准。: The source image keeps its proportions. Changing the canvas does not stretch or regenerate it. Actual output dimensions depend on the generated result.
保真与风格强度是创作指令，不是模型质量档位。透明棋盘格仅表示目标背景。: Preservation and style strength are creative instructions, not model quality levels. The checkerboard indicates a target transparent background only.
尺寸为生成目标，不保证精确像素；不会通过拉伸或压缩原图来凑尺寸。: Dimensions are targets, not guaranteed pixels. Original images will not be stretched or compressed to fit.
多张图片可能依次生成，实际耗时取决于任务与可用额度。: Multiple images may be generated sequentially. Time depends on the task and available quota.
1.0 正式版由作者确认后发布；当前版本用于测试。: Version 1.0 will be released only after the author's approval. This is a test build.

项目已有任务正在执行，请等待完成后再生成。: This project already has a running task. Wait for it to finish.
添加参考图后，才能针对具体主体或风格进行保留与借鉴。: Add a reference image to preserve a specific subject or borrow its visual style.
Codex 未连接，暂时无法生成。: Codex is disconnected. Generation is unavailable.
